modalities.evidence: derived dataset from 3 Electronic Health Record databases

output.population: Patients from MIMIC-IV, eICU-CRD-1 and eICU-CRD-2 contributing 13,251 temperature pairs with values between 30°C to 45°C
output.summary: Paired contact and infrared temperature measurements taken within one hour of each other, linked to demographics and hospital data, to study racial and ethnic disparities in infrared thermometry.
